bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. No other bags are allowed inside.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
bagPolicy.note: Medically necessary items are allowed after search. Diaper bags do not count as medical; diaper supplies must go in a clear bag. For concert questions, call Arena Management at 865-974-0953.

parking.summary: Concert and special-event parking is $20, card only, with no cash accepted. Parking is available in adjacent lots and garages, and the venue publishes garage clearances ranging from 6 feet 6 inches to 8 feet 6 inches.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The reviewed official Food City Center venue guidance does not state a specific rideshare pickup or drop-off policy.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food City Center has permanent concession stands plus portable locations at selected events. The venue lists items including pizza, pretzels, hot dogs, hamburgers, chicken strips, lemonade, ice cream, nachos, popcorn, candy, Moe's, Great American Cookie, Calhoun's BBQ, Coca-Cola products, and Dasani water.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is located throughout the arena and is first-come, first-served when you order tickets. Staff can help with ushering and easy-access seating; call 865-974-0953 or visit the Customer Service window on the main concourse at Gate E, and send accessibility requests as early as possible.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Food City Center has a no re-entry policy, and there are no pass-outs.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For concert and special event tickets, call 865-656-4444. For Tennessee Athletics events, call 865-656-1200.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance gates are at the top of the concrete pedestrian ramps on the east and west sides of the building, and the ticket office is at street level off Phillip Fulmer Way. Medical bag check is at Gate D on the east end.
